title: The entropy bound does not obstruct 32-byte shuffles
statement: log2(32!) is about 117.7 bits, and a single vpshufb control mask carries 32*4 = 128 bits. So an information-theoretic argument cannot give a length-2 lower bound for byte reversal; the bound in M.avx2.reverse.* is a lane-structure fact, which is why it needed a solver.

evidence.checker_command: python3 -c "import math,sys; b=math.log2(math.factorial(32)); print(f'log2(32!)={b:.3f}'); sys.exit(0 if b<128 else 1)"
evidence.negative_control: python3 -c "import math,sys; b=math.log2(math.factorial(32)); sys.exit(0 if b<117 else 1)"
